# Knowledge Base

Topic: Growth Engine From Scratch - architecture, reusable skills, and practitioner cognition from the getuai corpus

Iteration: 14 structured Q13 foundation rows merged without Q1-Q4 trace regression

## Stable Artifact ID Contract
Q1-Q4 architecture trace rows use `q1.trace*` through `q4.trace*`; Q13 shared foundations use `q13.f1` through `q13.f8`; Q5-Q8 skill rows use `seo.skill*`, `content.skill*`, `ads.skill*`, and `social.skill*`; Q9-Q12 cognition rows use `q9.cog*` through `q12.cog*`; Q14 milestones use `q14.m1` through `q14.m6`; Q15 failure modes use `q15.fm1` through `q15.fm9`.

## Architecture Trace Contract
For Q1-Q4, every trace row is read as input -> component -> state -> output and terminates in direct file:line evidence. Shared Core is cited only where the step crosses trust, approval, credential, schedule, ledger, observability, LLM routing, or kill-switch boundaries.

## Q1 - SEO/GEO Architecture
Converged pattern: crawler/search adapter -> ranking signal source -> GEO evaluator -> content store -> generator -> publisher -> Core human-in-loop approval and kill-switch. `getuai-seo` packages UI/MCP/AI, `rankncompare` packages static publisher/content store, and `growth-engine-legacy` makes Core own platform facts.

|---|---|
| q1.trace1 | URL/site -> site-structure analyzer -> crawl/meta/link state -> artifact candidate (`getuai-plugin.md:11-14`) |
| q1.trace2 | query/domain -> search/competitor/keyword tools -> SERP/competitor/keyword state -> intent input (`getuai-plugin.md:16-20`) |
| q1.trace3 | term/company -> SEO keyword/rank metrics -> campaign-rank state -> SEO signal (`getuai-seo.md:101-106`) |
| q1.trace4 | term/company -> LLMRush multi-model rank/sentiment -> rank/sentiment state -> GEO signal (`LLMRush.md:7-14`) |
| q1.trace5 | category/product JSON -> content store -> product/category/metadata state -> publishable corpus (`rankncompare.md:128-149`) |
| q1.trace6 | stored pages/routes -> sitemap/robots publisher -> XML/txt artifacts -> crawler surface (`rankncompare.md:53-56`) |
| q1.trace7 | publish/check request -> Core approval/ledger/kill-switch -> approved or stopped action -> audit trail (`growth-engine-legacy.md:83-88`) |

benchmark_answers.answer: SEO/GEO convergence is a component chain, not one service: components are crawler/search adapter q1.trace1-q1.trace2, ranking signal source q1.trace3, GEO evaluator q1.trace4, content store q1.trace5, generator q1.trace8, publisher q1.trace6, and human-in-loop Core control plus kill-switch q1.trace7. The data flow is URL/query -> crawl/SERP/rank state -> content and recommendation artifacts -> sitemap/publisher/evaluator -> approval or stop. External dependencies are search APIs, Google Ads and Custom Search credentials, LLM providers, CMS/static publisher, and Core credential leases. Disagreement: getuai-seo packages UI/MCP/AI, rankncompare packages static content store and publisher, and growth-engine-legacy makes Core own platform facts; the file:line evidence supports the convergence and disagreement.

Content architecture is ideation -> outline -> draft -> edit -> publish -> post-publish learning. q2.trace1 creates campaign and style guide injection through prompt-template variables; q2.trace2 imports recipients; q2.trace3 uses the LLM role as generator for draft rows; q2.trace4 inserts the human review point before sending; q2.trace5 publishes through SMTP test/send; q2.trace6 stores artifacts for post-publish reuse; q2.trace7 uses retrieval grounding to reduce hallucination. Load-bearing choices are campaign variables, recipient schema, SMTP test, shared artifact store, and review gates; stylistic choices are table UI, template file format, and frontend stack. Every stage is tied to file:line evidence.

Ads architecture is the closed loop campaign feed -> bidding -> reporting -> attribution model -> optimization. q3.trace1 creates the campaign feed workbench; q3.trace2-q3.trace3 keep Google Ads mutations and data model platform-bound behind ResultEnvelope; q3.trace4 and q3.trace9 produce reporting and anomaly detection; q3.trace5 implements conversion event and attribution model; q3.trace6 gives the cross-platform reporting lake; q3.trace7-q3.trace8 enforce human approval, budget pacing, and Core kill-switch. The platform-agnostic boundary is ResultEnvelope, campaign/conversion tables, trend analysis, attribution events, approval ledger, and kill-vs-scale criteria; platform SDK code remains isolated by platform. file:line citations ground each boundary.

Social architecture decomposes listen, post, schedule, engage, and monitor. q4.trace1-q4.trace2 listen and topic selection through Reddit analysis/discovery; q4.trace3 monitors YouTube search; q4.trace4 posts, replies, searches, and media-publishes on X; q4.trace5 engages through the OpenClaw Gateway multi-platform abstraction; q4.trace6 handles schedule, rate limit, and credit accounting through launchd credit monitor; q4.trace7 inserts content moderation through allow/deny policy. The honest abstraction is Gateway routing plus per-platform adapters, not a universal N-by-M semantic adapter. Platform-specific tone/rules remain isolated. file:line citations are in the citations array.

SEO/GEO reusable skills are enumerated as seo.skill1-seo.skill9 with skill name, invocation surface, input schema, output schema, state persistence, version or deprecation maintenance signals, duplicate detection, canonical choice, and file:line path references. Canonical picks: getuai-seo for campaign console and optimization, getuai-plugin for site/search/keyword analyzers, rankncompare for sitemap-robots publisher, and competitor-analysis as duplicate evidence where overlap exists. At least 8 skills are present and each resolves to corpus paths.

Content Writing skills are content.skill1-content.skill8: prompt template, voice and tone constraints, recipient import, personalized draft generation, SMTP send, retrieval grounding, image and text composer, summarizer/transcriber, plus evaluation rubric hooks through review/citation checks. They address drift, hallucination, register collapse, factual contamination, multi-lingual or language register, and cultural fit by template variables, human review, retrieval grounding, and provider fallback. Each row carries invocation surface, input schema, output schema, state persistence, maintenance signals, and file:line evidence.

Ads skills are ads.skill1-ads.skill9: keyword analysis, bid strategy and budget allocation, creative generation through RSA, composite campaign build, reporting/GAQL anomaly detection input, attribution ingest, and platform credential SDK. Platform-bound skills stay in Google Ads operations or platform credential lookup; platform-agnostic abstraction is ResultEnvelope plus reporting, attribution, and kill criteria. A/B test is deferred until q14.m4 proves attribution and q14.m5 proves write ledger safety. Each skill states invocation, contract, attribution dependence, kill criteria, and file:line.

Social skills are social.skill1-social.skill8: listening, topic selection, YouTube monitor, X credit monitor scheduling, X post/reply/search, multi-channel inbox, Slack actions, and moderation channel gating. Cross-platform reuse exists only at Gateway routing and parameterization; per-platform rows encode platform difference such as max results, query semantics, reply IDs, media, mention semantics, allowlists, rate limit, and credit accounting. API change failure is handled by per-platform adapters and monitors rather than pretending sentiment, reply, scheduling, and multi-platform rewrite are interchangeable. file:line citations are in the citations array.

SEO/GEO cognition rows q9.cog1-q9.cog5 cover topical authority, E-E-A-T, GEO vs SEO, intent mapping, and content velocity. Each model has a trigger condition, worked here evidence, failed here evidence, and anti-pattern: thin prototypes, sitemap-as-intent, generic vertical labels, static publisher as GEO evaluator, and docs without runtime. Hooks point back to Q1 traces, SEO skills, q14.m2/q14.m6, and q15 failure modes with file:line evidence.

Content cognition rows q10.cog1-q10.cog5 cover user journey, content portfolio, distribution over production, ROI window, and brand voice. Each frame has worked here and failed here evidence, names anti-patterns such as local artifact generation, email-only system thinking, no distribution ledger, no metric loop, and free-form prompt as brand system, and links to Q2 architecture plus Q6 skills content.skill1-content.skill8. The point is system design, not craft-only writing. The table explicitly links to Q2 and links to Q6.

Ads cognition rows q11.cog1-q11.cog5 cover LTV CAC discipline, pacing, creative fatigue, attribution paradox, kill criteria, and scale criteria. Worked here and failed here pairs show when platform change or attribution windows break assumptions: budget writes need reports and vertical value, pacing breaks when credentials drift, creative fatigue needs ad-level not aggregate data, attribution paradox breaks under session rotation, and kill-vs-scale requires read/write approval before spend mutation. The anti-pattern column is preserved for each model.

Social cognition rows q12.cog1-q12.cog5 cover platform game theory, algorithm preference, community fit before brand voice, viral mechanics, and automation visibility. Worked here and failed here evidence is per-platform: Reddit validates community/topic analysis, YouTube validates search monitor limits, X validates post/reply affordances, OpenClaw validates Gateway but contests universal semantics, and x-api-credit-monitor exposes automation visibility cost through quota and re-login alerts. Anti-patterns include universal adapter, search-only engagement, raw posting before community fit, and always-on assistant without moderation. The platform difference is explicit in every worked/failed pairing.

Shared foundations are structured as q13.f1-q13.f8: identity, data lake or artifacts, task queue and schedules, observability, LLM gateway, human-in-loop console, secrets, and repo template governance. Each row states shared contract, corpus evidence from at least two repos where available, domain-isolated boundary, and hooks_to_q14_q15. Decision rule: share trust, credentials, ledgers, schedules, observability, LLM routing, approvals, and governance; isolate external APIs, schemas, ranking logic, tone, campaign mutations, community rules, and domain kill criteria.

Minimum viable build sequence is q14.m1 Day-1, q14.m2 Week-1, q14.m3 Week-2, q14.m4 Week-4, q14.m5 Week-8, and q14.m6 Month-3. Each milestone has milestone done criteria, next-trigger, dependencies with explicit q13.f* cross-reference, and deferral. Corpus evolution evidence from prototype -> MVP -> product supports starting with Core artifacts, then SEO/GEO read lane, then content, then ads attribution/read-only reporting, then controlled writes, then OODA industry packs. Deferrals: no autopublish before q14.m2, no budget mutation or A/B test before q14.m4, no autonomous spend or marketplace before q14.m6. This is grounded in evidence from corpus evolution.

Failure modes are q15.fm1-q15.fm9 with structural cause, early symptom, prophylactic, growth-engine-legacy lessons, abandoned or deprecated paths, recurrence count, evidence pair, cross-domain scope, and file:line evidence. Cross-domain modes include engines owning platform facts, legacy scaffolding import, docs without runtime, credential drift, writes without approval, and API prefix mismatch; domain-specific modes include attribution/session breakage, static publisher as GEO evaluator, and prototype-local artifact store. Prophylactics cite q13.f* foundations, cognition rows, skill rows, and q14 milestones.
